questions.question: How many customers are there?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

questions.question: How many customers live in Kochi?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Kochi'

questions.question: What is the most expensive product and its price?
questions.gold: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many orders were cancelled?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

questions.question: List the names of the products in the Fitness category.
questions.gold: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Fitness'

questions.question: How many orders were placed in March 2025?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-03-01' AND order_date < '2025-04-01'

questions.question: What is the average price of products in the Electronics category?
questions.gold: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

questions.question: How many products cost more than 2000?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price > 2000

questions.question: How many orders are there for each status?
questions.gold: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

questions.question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
questions.gold: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

questions.question: Which product category generated the most revenue from completed orders, and how much?
questions.gold: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total spend on completed orders, and how much did each spend?
questions.gold: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many distinct customers placed at least one order in 2025?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

questions.question: What is the total quantity sold in each product category, counting completed orders only?
questions.gold: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category

questions.question: What was the revenue from completed orders in Q3 2025 (July to September)?
questions.gold: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01'

questions.question: Which city has the most customers, and how many?
questions.gold: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many orders did the customer named Aarav Nair place?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Aarav Nair'

questions.question: What is the average number of line items per order?
questions.gold: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

questions.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
questions.gold: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

questions.question: Show the revenue from completed orders for each month of 2025.
questions.gold: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY month

questions.question: Which products have never appeared in any order?
questions.gold: SELECT name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

questions.question: For each product category, what percentage of total completed-order revenue does it account for, rounded to 1 decimal place?
questions.gold: SELECT p.category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) FROM order_items oi2 JOIN orders o2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id WHERE o2.status = 'completed'), 1) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category

questions.question: Which customers spent more than 100000 in total on completed orders, and how much did each spend?
questions.gold: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING spend > 100000

questions.question: What percentage of all orders were returned, rounded to 1 decimal place?
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'returned') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders

questions.question: Who is the top-spending customer in each city, counting completed orders only?
questions.gold: SELECT city, name, spend FROM (SELECT c.city AS city, c.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS spend, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS rn FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id) WHERE rn = 1
